_comment: Asset recipe for the normalised frames. This is the tuning record: the numbers
here were chosen by eye off assets/preview/calibration.png, and are baked into
assets/frames/ by tools/normalize.mjs so that every frame is the same canvas
with the dog at the same size, on the same floor line, at the same centre.
scale is applied to the source sprite before it is placed on the canvas.
bust frames are head-and-shoulders; they never stand on the floor, so their
scale only decides how large the head is inside the same canvas.
